assertions.text: Reissue validates the locked failed delivery and source/holds, then creates one successor and its trace in one transaction. Injected failure rolls back both; racing operators produce one successor.
Require an explicit uncertain-effects acknowledgment, preserve the failed request and original attribution, and distinguish reported task assessment from handling/execution.

alternatives.option: New request and trace under existing operator authority
Reset the failed delivery or automatically retry uncertain work
Create another delivery under the old event
Keep failure inspection and manual publication separate only

verification_criteria: Final focused queue/reissue/review tests and real operator CLI probe
reopening_conditions: A new attempt creator bypasses delivery locking
Acceptance semantics change or need independent attestation
Evidence of review-query or collection-lock contention

Selected concept implementation-atomicity-scope; its material obligations are satisfied for this bounded mutation.
Operator review sections are current observations; reissue revalidates independently. Latest assessment is retained testimony, not independent task acceptance.
One successor per failed delivery prevents duplicate operator retries. A successor that later fails can itself be reviewed and reissued. Prior external effects remain possible.
Queued requests have no delivery yet and are exposed in a separate bounded page. No performance, usefulness or full-v1 acceptance claim.
